name: moor_crows
text_prompt: Several black crows perch along a wire fence crossing a grassy coastal moor under a blue sky. Eye-level shot. In the first moments, the nearest crow turns toward the viewer, spreads and flaps its wings and caws. Otherwise it stays calm and still. Photoreal, bright natural light.
interaction_prompt: the nearest crow turns toward the viewer, spreads and flaps its wings and caws
